new_statements.quote: Betont werden die Worte immer auf der vorletzten Silbe, außer in einigen besonderen Fällen, wo die Betonung durch Akzente angegeben ist. Alle angehängten Partikeln und Pronomina gehen ganz im Worte auf, so daß sie auch den Akzent verlegen, z. B. tóta, aber totá-i.
new_statements.translation: Words are always stressed on the penultimate syllable, except in a few special cases where the stress is indicated by accent marks. All attached particles and pronouns are fully absorbed into the word, so that they also shift the accent, e.g. tóta but totá-i.
new_statements.citation: Tauern, Odo D. 1928. Beitrag zur Kenntnis der Sprachen und Dialekte von Seran. Anthropos 23(5-6): 1000-1020 [section 'Kurzer Abriß einer Grammatik der Wemale-Sprache, wie sie in Japjo gesprochen wird', Lautlehre].

new_statements.rule_in_words: Regular penultimate word stress; enclitic particles and suffixed pronouns count as part of the word, so stress moves rightward to stay penultimate (tóta -> totá-i). A few lexical exceptions are marked with accents in Tauern's word lists/texts.
new_statements.exceptions: 'einige besondere Fälle' (a few special cases) with non-penultimate stress, marked by written accents in the vocabulary/texts; not enumerated in the sketch.
new_statements.domain_note: Domain is the word including attached particles and possessive/pronominal suffixes (stress shifts with them), i.e. penult of the whole cliticized word; based on Tauern's 1911-12 fieldwork on the dialect of the village Japjo (Japio), interior West Seram.
new_statements.identity_note: Tauern's sketch describes the Wemale dialect of the village Japjo (Japio) in interior West Seram as recorded in 1911-12; Collins 1983:54 refers to these same notes as being 'on Ahiolo' (Tala River basin, the former South Wemale [tlw] area). ISO 639-3 merged South Wemale [tlw] into [weo] 'Wemale' in 2012 (CR 2011-083), and Glottolog nort2864 is now the whole Wemale language, so no separate glottocode applies; the modern Indonesian papers (Erniati & Sanjoko 2020) describe the South Wemale dialect of Negeri Hunitetu but say nothing about stress.
